title: Stable-anchor performance manifest and compatibility bridge
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a production-ready "golden-anchor" manifest artifact and a compatibility bridge that lets runtime, console, and publish pipelines agree on a single source of truth for Redwood-verified performance characteristics (latency p50/p95, throughput, cost-normalized tokens) across model versions and regions. The manifest will be OCI-backed, signed, and support lightweight delta patches for fast refreshes. The compatibility bridge maps model variants and quantization profiles to canonical anchors so rollouts, pinning, and automated fallbacks are deterministic across hosted, dedicated and private deployments.
tasks: Draft golden-anchor manifest schema (fields, provenance, signatures, cost-normalization) - owner: PM
Prototype OCI artifact layout and retention rules - owner: ENG
Implement manifest signer/verifier using KMS/HSM integration - owner: SEC/ENG
Add delta patch generator to publish pipeline (produce incremental diffs) - owner: ENG
Build compatibility bridge service (lookup + mapping rules + compatibility score) - owner: ENG
Console UI: surface anchor bindings, pin reasons, and rollback controls - owner: DESIGN/FE
E2E verification harness: sample workloads across regions and hardware to validate anchor assertions - owner: SRE/ENG
Automated lint and stability checks for profile changes (cost drift guard) - owner: ENG
Store signed manifests in release registry and add provenance links to model onboarding docs - owner: PM
acceptance_criteria: There exists a JSON/YAML manifest schema with fields for latency/throughput/cost anchors, region_affinity, model_variant_mappings, and signature metadata
Publish pipeline can emit a signed OCI artifact and an incremental delta patch for each profile update
Runtime can query the compatibility bridge and resolve a pinned model to a compatible variant with a compatibility_score >= 0.75
Console shows manifest version, pin bindings, and provides a one-click rollback to previous signed anchor
Automated E2E harness validates published anchors against sampled workloads with pass/fail and exposes regressions to the dashboard
Security review signoff for signer/verifier and KMS integration is complete
Documentation pages updated with manifest spec, pinning semantics, and rollback playbook
